exchange.note: Mean tickets bought by members on Ticket Exchange per PL home match. No listings denominator or conversion rate published. Cup Ticket Exchange unavailable in 2025-26 (2025-26 PDF p10).

prices.stands: Main Stand|Sir Kenny Dalglish Stand|Anfield Road Stand

policy.caution: Definition-sensitive descriptive contrast: 2024-25 says all stadium tickets; 2025-26 says home tickets. Scope equivalence is unconfirmed. The bootstrap reflects opponent resampling only, not measurement uncertainty or a causal effect.

model.decision: Exploratory benchmark only. Nineteen irregular fixtures in a consistent target scope cannot establish annual seasonality or reliable stationarity. No ARIMA/SARIMA or operational future forecast is fitted.
model.validation: Three expanding windows, 10/13/16 training fixtures, next 3 fixtures each. Fixed alpha=10; no tuning on test data. Nine unique held-out fixtures. Baselines recalculated using training only.
